ai_tools_snapshot.title: AI Tools Snapshot
ai_tools_snapshot.content:
AI TOOLS SNAPSHOT
Category | Pedro uses | Best today | Alternative | Cost/Plan | Migration effort | Switch? | Reason
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
Coding / Agents | Claude Code + GPT Codex | Claude Code (Haiku 5.5) / DeepSeek Super-Agent | GitHub Copilot | Already subscribed (Claude Pro) / DeepSeek: Free (open-source) / GitHub Copilot: $10/month or $100/year | Low (Claude Code update) / Medium (DeepSeek setup) | Consider | Claude Code updated today to default Haiku 5.5 for Pro users, and DeepSeek launched a new free autonomous coding agent.
Excel / Spreadsheets | Claude.ai | Google Sheets with Gemini / GPT for Work | Slaide | Google Sheets with Gemini: Free (with Google Workspace/AI plans) / GPT for Work: Usage-based pricing / Slaide: Free tier, then from €7.99/month. | Medium | Upgrade | Dedicated tools like Google Sheets with Gemini or GPT for Work offer integrated, specialized AI functions for spreadsheets that Claude.ai lacks.
Presentations | Claude.ai | Gamma | NextDocs / Gemini for Google Slides | Gamma: Free tier (400 credits) / NextDocs: Free tier / Gemini for Google Slides: Free (with Google Workspace business accounts). | Medium | Upgrade | Gamma offers comprehensive deck generation and export from a prompt, providing more specialized presentation features than Claude.ai.
Documents / Word | Claude.ai | Claude.ai / Notion AI | Gemini for Google Workspace | Already subscribed (Claude Pro) / Notion AI: Free tier / Gemini for Google Workspace: Free (with Google Workspace business accounts). | Low (Claude.ai) / Medium (Notion AI) | Optimal | Claude.ai is already a strong tool for long documents and precise instructions, making it optimal for general document creation.
LaTeX / Overleaf | Overleaf + Claude.ai | TypeTeX / LetX | Bibby AI | TypeTeX: Free tier / LetX: Free editor, limited Lexi runs / Overleaf AI: Basic allowance on free plan. | High | Consider | Specialized AI LaTeX editors like TypeTeX and LetX offer advanced features like compile error fixing and image-to-LaTeX conversion that Claude.ai lacks.
Knowledge Management | Claude.ai | Notion AI / Gemini Notebook | Read AI | Notion AI: Free tier / Gemini Notebook: Free (with Google account) / Read AI: Free (personal knowledge graph). | High | Upgrade | Dedicated knowledge management tools like Notion AI or Gemini Notebook provide better organization, search, and retrieval across diverse information sources.
Image Generation | GPT-4o image / Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) | Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) | VAKPixel / ZSky AI | Google Nano Banana 2: Free (100 images/day) / VAKPixel: Free (credits via ads) / ZSky AI: Free (unlimited). | Optimal | Optimal | Google Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) received a significant update on October 30, 2026, improving visual quality and prompt adherence.
Research / Web Search | Perplexity | Perplexity / Google Gemini | Microsoft Copilot | Perplexity: Free tier (limited Pro Searches) / Google Gemini: Free tier (Flash-Lite model) / Microsoft Copilot: Free (with Microsoft account). | Optimal | Optimal | Perplexity is highly rated for research with cited sources and current events, making it an optimal choice for Pedro's needs.
Transcription / Audio | None | OpenAI Whisper (self-hosted) / Otter.ai | TranscribeGo / MirrorCaption | OpenAI Whisper: Free (open-source, self-hosted) / Otter.ai: Free (300 mins/month) / TranscribeGo: Free (10 mins/month) / MirrorCaption: 1 free hour. | Medium (Whisper setup) / Low (cloud services) | Not using | OpenAI Whisper offers unlimited, private transcription when self-hosted, while Otter.ai provides a generous free tier for cloud-based meeting transcription.
Task Automation | Claude.ai | Claude.ai / DeepSeek Super-Agent | Generic AI platforms with automation features | Already subscribed (Claude Pro) / DeepSeek: Free (open-source) | Low (Claude.ai) / Medium (DeepSeek setup) | Optimal | Claude Pro offers strong general-purpose AI capabilities for task automation, and DeepSeek's new Super-Agent provides a compelling open-source option for coding-specific automation.

Takeaway: Pedro should evaluate DeepSeek's newly released open-source Super-Agent for coding, as it offers proactive and autonomous support that could enhance his current coding workflow.
